rows.text: RRCS connection to the Artist system
rows.source: RRCS 9.0.RR1-11 log, 2026-10-06 22:29:34 to 22:43: with the connection down ('The network is not enabled') every request of two other control systems was answered 'The network connection to artist is not enabled (error code=11)' — 4135 in 14 minutes. Nothing can be read or controlled in that state. The value comes from the notifications ConnectArtistRestored / ConnectArtistFailure / GatewayShutdown (specification 9.0.1 §9.7).

RRCS's own Alarm Manager rates this condition Minor: 'Alarm activated … path="Director", type="Panels offline", severity="Minor", text="342 panel(s) are offline…"' (RRCS 9.0.RR1-11 log, 2026-10-06 22:23:46). The value comes from the notifications PortActive / PortInactive (§9.7). The 30 s hold is a site choice, not a device number: a panel that reboots is back within it.

every value the gateway reports. The node and client card notifications of §9.7 (UpstreamFailed, DownstreamFailed, NodeControllerFailed, NodeControllerReboot, ClientFailed) carry no severity and RRCS has not been seen rating them: they stay info until the plant gives each a severity.
